info.description: The header: wordmark, menu links, and the sticky order button.

logo_text.description: The wordmark in the top-left corner. Set as text so it stays sharp at every screen size.

items.description: Menu links, in display order. Between 1 and 8 - more than 8 will not fit the header.

order_button_label.description: Text on the header's order button.

order_product_name.description: Product name on the header's order button.

order_price.description: Price on the header's order button. Change it here and in the Hero section - they appear in two places.
